versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated the default model from u1-insuremed to u2-med in the documentation.

- Initial release of the 医保理赔单据合规审核与医保费用核算规则应用 skill.
- Supports two main tasks: 医保费用核算与规则应用 (insure-calc) and 医保理赔单据合规审核 (insure-check).
- Flexible input methods: direct string, stdin, or JSON/JSONL files.
- Integrates with an internal medical large language model ("u1-insuremed"); allows endpoint and parameter customization.
- Includes command-line interface for querying with various options and batch processing support.
- Outputs structured JSON results; includes options for text-only output and dry-run.
